WHY: Stored Brand AI prompts are OPEN_ENDED and shared. Pairwise Presence on scenario measurement grains equals a scenario-level shared denominator without collapsing to grains where every peer was mentioned. Global all-cohort positive-mention intersection would be too sparse. Pairwise preserves evidence and stays comparable.

commonGrainDistribution.note: Minimum set at or below observed P25 only when P25 >= 8; otherwise keep 8 to avoid weakening the gate.

intersectionDesignAudit.A_PAIRWISE: RECOMMENDED — comparable subject vs each peer on shared scenario grains; then aggregate peer Presence values.
intersectionDesignAudit.B_GLOBAL_INTERSECTION: REJECTED for calculation — intersection of grains where all 8–10 peers appear is too sparse.
intersectionDesignAudit.C_MIN_SUBCOHORT: FUTURE — may drop weakest peers to grow grains; not used now because it reintroduces sample-size substitution risk.
